brief: The canvas displays an immense, decaying architectural framework rendered in the fine, precise lines of ink on vellum, resembling the intricate detail of a 1960s pen plotter drawing. The structure, representing the skeletal supports of a Gothic cathedral, fills the space with complex, intersecting geometric arches and nodes. These interconnected forms are subjected to a rhythmic nodal expansion: at predictable intervals, the nodal points pulse and blossom outward, causing visible geometric distortions that ripple through the supporting arches. The lines are starkly black on a pale background, and the movement is purely cyclical and internal, giving the illusion of structural life.

statement: This sketch depicts the skeletal framework of a vast, decaying Gothic cathedral rendered in the precise, clean lines reminiscent of 1960s pen plotter drawings. The structure consists of interconnected nodes and beams that pulse rhythmically, creating visible distortions that ripple through the architectural form. Each nodal point expands and contracts in a cyclical pattern, causing the supporting arches to subtly warp and bend, giving the impression of structural life and decay. The stark black-on-pale background emphasizes the geometric precision of the lines, while the rhythmic pulsation creates an internal, hypnotic movement that transforms static architecture into a living, breathing form.
